limitations.note: The clocked counter fixes the square-wave defect, but the triangle rewrite changes reset and mode-entry behavior that the reference preserves: the first triangle sample from zero with the direction flag clear is now 1 instead of 31.
The square-wave test exercised the counter fix, but the triangle checks encoded the rewritten startup and re-entry behavior instead of checking that those outputs stayed unchanged.
